environment.scope: Shared development environment, not clean installed-package qualification.

audit: Hydrophobic, halogen and SMARTS hbond readers exposed the shared declaration directly. Metal reader copies top-level fields, with nested aliases reproduced using a controlled nested declaration. Interaction constructors already deep-copy parameter metadata; all attributed consumers now also detach method_reference at the common boundary. No blanket claim of a reproduced flat alias in every detector.
exclusions: No scientific-model validation, runtime benchmark, installed/cross-platform qualification, new API, dependency or publication.
